key_claim: SPS nanostructuring sustains high zT via simultaneous kappa suppression and maintained sigma

evidence_sentences.zT_value: Spark-plasma-sintered nanostructured Bi0.3Sb1.7Te3 alloys exhibit a peak zT of 1.2 @ 350 K, with a Seebeck coefficient of -240 uV/K, an electrical conductivity of 850 S/cm, and a total thermal conductivity of 1.05 W/mK at 350 K.
evidence_sentences.carrier_concentration: Hall measurements give a carrier concentration of 3.2e19 cm-3.
